title: Blind + Revision — UF, SW, Backtracking, DP, Trees (Jun 22–27)
description: No Trie/LRU this week. Base stays 1 blind + 1 revision daily, with optional micro-revision on Mon/Wed/Fri if energy is high. Reintroduces DP and Trees while keeping RED focus on Union-Find, fixed-size Sliding Window, and Backtracking rollback.
